name: mcp-azure
description: Azure DevOps Server MCP server (self-hosted, PAT auth). Opt-in per machine; configure with /plugin configure.

ado_pat.title: Azure DevOps personal access token
ado_pat.description: PAT with Code (Read), Work Items (Read & Write), Build (Read), Wiki (Read).

ado_default_project.title: Azure DevOps default project
ado_default_project.description: Optional. Project used when a request doesn't name one.

ado_api_version.title: Azure DevOps REST API version
ado_api_version.description: Highest version your server supports: Server 2022 = 7.0, 2020 = 6.0, 2019 = 5.0, Services = 7.1.
